description: Typewell Geology features. The typewell CSVs include a `Geology` column (categorical layer labels) indexed by TVT. Using the DTW best-lag alignment from exp006, look up the typewell's Geology label at the aligned TVT for every lateral row. Encode it as both a categorical (LightGBM native) and via target encoding (fold-safe). This is a new signal channel — geology layers carry direct TVT information that GR alone smears.
implementation_notes: Reuse DTW features from src/features.py (added by exp006). Do NOT recompute.

For each lateral row, compute aligned_tvt = current TVT estimate from dtw_best_lag (effectively the typewell TVT the lateral GR aligns to). Look up Geology label at that depth in the per-well typewell.
Target encoding of geology label MUST be computed inside each CV fold (out-of-fold) to prevent leakage. Use mean TVT per geology, smoothed with prior mean (e.g., bayesian smoothing with k=20).
Layer thickness and distance-to-top/bottom: from the typewell, find the run of consecutive same-Geology rows containing the aligned depth; record total thickness and current row's position within it.
Pass categorical feature via LightGBM's categorical_feature parameter.
Use GroupKFold(5) by well_id. Target to beat: exp006 (36.394). Add code to src/features.py.
